q: My Jenkins pipeline fails with exit code 1 but I don't see an error message
a: Look at the last shell step before the failure. Exit code 1 is a generic failure. Run the failing command locally with `set -x` to see each sub-command. Check if `set -e` is active (it stops on any error). Also check if a linter or test tool returned non-zero without printing to stdout.

q: Jenkins can't run docker commands on the agent — permission denied
a: Add the jenkins user to the docker group on the agent: `sudo usermod -aG docker jenkins` then restart the agent. Alternatively, use a Docker-in-Docker (DinD) sidecar or configure the agent to use rootless Docker.

q: How do I pass secrets securely in a Jenkins pipeline without them appearing in logs?
a: Use `withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'my-secret', variable: 'MY_SECRET')]) { ... }`. Jenkins automatically masks the value in logs. Never use `echo $MY_SECRET` — use it only as an argument to a command.

q: My build is stuck in the queue forever
a: Check: 1) Is there an agent with the required label online? (Manage Jenkins → Nodes) 2) Is the agent at capacity? 3) Does the Jenkinsfile `agent { label 'X' }` label match exactly? 4) Check for builds that are hung and holding executors — abort them if needed.

q: Pipeline fails with groovy.lang.MissingMethodException for a shared library function
a: The function doesn't exist in the library version being loaded. Check: 1) `@Library('my-lib@version')` — pin to a specific tag/branch. 2) The function is in `vars/` not `src/`. 3) The library is configured in Jenkins → System → Global Pipeline Libraries.

q: My pipeline hangs and never finishes
a: Wrap the build in a timeout: `timeout(time: 30, unit: 'MINUTES') { ... }`. Common causes: interactive prompt waiting for input (use `-y`/`--non-interactive` flags), docker pull rate limit, or a test that deadlocks. Check the build log for the last line printed before it hung.

q: Agent runs out of disk space
a: 1) Add a post step: `post { always { cleanWs() } }`. 2) Enable Workspace Cleanup Plugin. 3) Run `docker system prune -f` regularly on agents. 4) Move artifact storage to Artifactory instead of keeping in workspace.
